dashboard.title: Dashboard

stockIn.title: Stock In
stockIn.subtitle: Every stock-in automatically creates/adds a stock lot based on its Project Ref/Cost Centre/Cost Code.
stockIn.confirmDelete: Delete stock-in record "{{ref}}"? Stock balance will NOT be automatically rolled back.
stockIn.colProject: Project Ref / Cost Centre / Cost Code
stockIn.markAsPoSubtitle: Fill in the vendor and price for each item in "{{ref}}", plus 1 PO document for this record.
stockIn.markAsDoSubtitle: Upload the DO document for "{{ref}}". Stock will be added once confirmed.
stockIn.markAsDoStockHint: Once confirmed, this item's stock will be added to the balance and become available for Stock Out.
stockIn.editLockedTitle: Can't be edited via the normal form
stockIn.editLockedHint: This record has already progressed to PO/DO status, so it can no longer be edited through the normal edit form. If it really needs changing, use the Super Admin Edit menu (a reason is required).
stockIn.poDocumentHint: 1 document for this whole record (e.g. scan of the purchase order document).
stockIn.doDocumentHint: 1 document for this whole record (e.g. scan of the delivery order document).
stockIn.notPrNotice: This record is no longer PR status.
stockIn.notPoNotice: This record must be PO status first before it can be marked as DO.
stockIn.overrideEditWarning: This edits data outside the normal PR → PO → DO flow. Use only for correcting mistakes, and always fill in the reason below.
stockIn.formLockedTitle: This record can no longer be edited through the regular form
stockIn.formLockedHint: Its status is no longer PR. If something needs correcting, please contact a Super Admin.
stockIn.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this is being changed outside the normal flow...
stockIn.replaceDocumentHint: Leave empty to keep the current document.

stockOut.title: Stock Out
stockOut.subtitle: Can draw from multiple source projects at once — the breakdown is recorded per line.
stockOut.sourceStock: Stock Source (can combine multiple projects) — Total: {{total}}
stockOut.confirmDelete: Delete stock-out record "{{ref}}"? Stock balance will NOT be automatically rolled back.
stockOut.selectItemFirst: Select an item first to see available lots.
stockOut.overrideEditWarning: Editing a stock-out record is restricted to Super Admins, since it affects stock balances that may already be relied on elsewhere. Always fill in the reason below.
stockOut.reasonPlaceholder: Explain why this record is being changed...

stockBalance.title: Stock Balance
stockBalance.subtitle: Per lot — shows which Project Ref/Cost Centre/Cost Code each item's remaining stock came from.
stockBalance.colProjectRef: Project Ref / Cost Centre / Cost Code
stockBalance.detailSubtitle: Balance breakdown per Project Ref / Cost Centre / Cost Code
stockBalance.addDirectWarning: This adds stock straight to the balance, completely bypassing the PR → PO → DO flow. Use only for cases like entering existing physical stock that was never recorded through the normal process.
stockBalance.addDirectReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this stock is being added directly (e.g. initial data migration, found existing physical stock)...
stockBalance.adjustWarning: This directly overwrites the lot's balance to a new number. Use only to fix a mistake or reconcile with a physical stock count. Always fill in the reason.
stockBalance.adjustReasonPlaceholder: Explain why this balance is being corrected (e.g. physical stock count result, fixing a previous input mistake)...
stockBalance.projectNameHint: This is what distinguishes this batch's project, even if the codes above are reused elsewhere.
